author: J. C. Kemp
title: Third grade leads Banfield Elementary in math MCA participation for 2024-25
text:
Third-grade students at Banfield Elementary School made up the largest group participating in the math portion of the 2024-25 MCA, as reported by the Minnesota Department of Education .
Among 228 students who completed that section at Banfield Elementary, 118 were third graders.
Based on test standards, 39% of third-grade participants demonstrated proficiency in mathematics.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are state-administered tests designed to evaluate student achievement toward Minnesota academic standards and satisfy legislative requirements at both state and federal levels. Math, reading and science are the subjects covered, depending on the grade assessed. Most students take the MCA. The Alt MCA is offered to students receiving special education services if they meet eligibility rules.
Current proficiency rates for Minnesota’s MCA tests have fallen from pre-pandemic figures , as stated by Minnesota’s Report Card. For instance, math proficiency declined by over 7% compared to 2019, while reading proficiency decreased by nearly 5% in the same period.
